query:
UPDATE "User" u
        SET "isAgent" = FALSE
        WHERE u."email" = $1
          AND u."isAgent"
          AND NOT u."tutorialComplete"
          AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "UserApiKey" k WHERE k.user_id = u."id")
          AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM team_invite ti WHERE ti.email = u."email" AND ti.is_agent
          )
